AGOGO BELLS, COWBELL AND SLAPSTICK

Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL)
Author: Versilian Studios LLC
Source: https://versilian-studios.com/vcsl/
Repository: https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL
Pinned source commit: c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e
License: CC0-1.0 (full text at ../CC0-1.0.txt)
The publisher explicitly permits commercial software use.

Agogo: Agogo_Low_v2_rr1_Mid.wav and Agogo_High_v2_rr1_Mid.wav.
Cowbell: Cowbell2_Normal_v2_rr1_Mid.wav and Cowbell2_Muted_v2_rr1_Mid.wav.
Slapstick: slapstick_rr1.wav.

Native pitch, speed and stereo image retained. Quiet lead/tails trimmed,
levels balanced with constant gain, short endpoint fades and 16-bit TPDF
dither. No synthetic replacement, pitch shifting, compression or EQ.
Open/Muted use different recordings of the same cowbell; the exact muting
technique is not specified by the source.

Complete source URLs and source/derived SHA-256 hashes: PROVENANCE.json.
Reproducible preparation: scripts/prepare-bells-slapstick.py with the
pinned originals listed in scripts/bells-slapstick-sources.json.
